headline: Executive order on who is eligible to serve in the U.S. military, signed by President Biden in January 2021.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with the rules for who may serve in the U.S. armed forces. The title says its aim is to let all qualified Americans serve in uniform. No summary was provided, so the specific rules it changes cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: People who want to join the U.S. military
who_it_affects.how: The order addresses the eligibility rules that decide who can enlist or be commissioned.
The order may affect the rules about who can keep serving, though the title does not give details.

who_it_affects.group: The Department of Defense and military branches
who_it_affects.how: These agencies would be responsible for carrying out any changes to service eligibility rules.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 25, 2021; the title alone does not state an effective date or deadlines.
